Re-check each record against its first-party page: is the offer still as recorded, and what changed? A host that is gone becomes dead with the evidence of its death.
An audit of the first attempt judged these claims unsupported by their sources; settle each one first:
- netdisk-pan/china-mobile-cloud $.free_tier.stated: The page states a 20G base and 1T/2T activity grants, but not the claimed 1,000 GB (1 TB) Wikipedia figure; its 8T figure is a 尊享云 plan privilege.
- netdisk-pan/china-mobile-cloud $.egress.terms: The page states unthrottled uploads/downloads and member zero-rating, but it does not report forum consensus or the Baidu 0.1 MB/s and Quark 1.7 MB/s comparison.
- netdisk-pan/china-mobile-cloud $.free_tier.stated: The table gives 1000G free, no upload limit and no download limit; it does not state a 20G base, 1T/2T carrier promotions, or 8T membership promos.
- netdisk-pan/china-mobile-cloud $.egress.terms: The table shows no upload/download throttling and lists Baidu 0.1M/s and Quark 1.7M/s elsewhere, but it does not state member zero-rating or forum consensus.
- netdisk-pan/china-mobile-cloud $.free_tier.stated: This probe record only establishes that the intro URL answered 200 with 14,323 bytes; it states no storage allowance.
- netdisk-pan/china-unicom-wopan $.egress.terms: The body advertises 不限速 in the title; it contains no cross-carrier OpenList/WebDAV measurement of 100 Mbit/s up and 500 Mbit/s down.
- netdisk-pan/disroot-cloud $.reliability_note: The status page supports the outage details, but it does not state donation funding, manual review of extra storage, annual invoicing or EU VAT.
- netdisk-pan/disroot-cloud $.reliability_note: The 29.10.2026 update supports the disk/RAID/unreadable-sector recovery details, but it does not state donation funding, manual storage review, annual invoices or VAT.
- netdisk-pan/disroot-cloud $.free_tier.stated: The service page states 2GB cloud storage only; it does not state the 1GB mail, 500MB CryptPad, per-year fees or 21% VAT.
- netdisk-pan/disroot-cloud $.reliability_note: This probe record only shows a 200 response after a 301; it contains no reliability history or storage-failure details.
- netdisk-pan/gopro-cloud-quik $.free_tier.stated: The terms state the GoPro-captured allowance and 100GB/500GB non-GoPro allocations, but they do not state the USD 59.99/yr or USD 99.99/yr prices.
- netdisk-pan/gopro-cloud-quik $.limits[0].value: The terms make third-party-edited GoPro footage non-GoPro, but they do not state that media trimmed in the Quik app counts as GoPro content.
- netdisk-pan/huawei-mobile-cloud $.free_tier.stated: The table states 5G free with no listed limits; it does not state the 基础服务/会员服务 split, 50GB/200GB/2TB tiers or the CNY 698 six-way carpool price.
- netdisk-pan/huawei-mobile-cloud $.free_tier.stated: The portal only serves an app download; it states no free allowance, paid tiers or carpool price.
- netdisk-pan/lanzou-cloud $.free_tier.stated: The page states unlimited total storage, but it does not state a per-file cap or place that cap on a per-object field.
- netdisk-pan/lanzou-cloud $.egress.terms: This quote is about storage, not egress; the page also advertises unmetered downloads but does not state ad funding or the FAQ line 我们对下载速度不做任何限制.
- netdisk-pan/lanzou-cloud $.egress.terms: The page states unthrottled, unmetered, login-free downloads, but it does not state ad funding or the exact FAQ sentence 我们对下载速度不做任何限制.
